subject: ISO 27001 + FedRAMP readiness: roadmap & evidence request
body:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As AcmeCloud moves through our procurement review we need a clearer picture of Redwood's compliance roadmap for ISO 27001 and FedRAMP, and a short inventory of SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ evidence you can provide in the next 4–6 weeks. Specifically: 

- Target timeline for ISO 27001 certification (if planned) and key milestones.
- Where you are with FedRAMP readiness (assessment planned vs. ATO target).
- SOC 2 Type II recertification date and whether you can share a redacted report.
- SIG/CAIQ completion status and whether you can provide an evidence index.
- Any anticipated blockers (private deployments, KMS/HSM, multi-region data residency).

Can you share a one-page roadmap and an evidence checklist we can attach to the RFP? If helpful we can sync for 30 minutes — Carlos and I are flexible the week of May 26.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Senior Compliance Manager
RegCompliance Partners

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide that. High level: we are targeting an ISO 27001 certification program with an internal gap remediation plan kicking off in Q3 2025; for FedRAMP we are presently doing a readiness assessment and intend to complete remediation work by end of Q3 with an ATO pursuit timeline dependent on partner-sponsored authorization. SOC 2 Type II is current through Aug 2025 (we can share a redacted report).

I attached a short gap analysis and a draft evidence index to start (see attachments). Proposed next step: 30-min sync on Tue May 20 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the list and owners — does that work for you and Carlos?

Key owners (internal):
- Karthik Iyer — Program lead (roadmap/controls)
- Monica Patel — Evidence collection & artifacts
- Me (Neha) — customer-facing coordination and timelines

I'll ask Monica to pull the SIG/CAIQ status and upload a CAIQ export to Drive ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: ISO-gap-analysis.xlsx (stub), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (stub)

--

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Agreed — adding a few concrete milestones to the thread so Sarah/Acme have clarity: 

Planned high-level roadmap:
- May–Jun 2025: complete current readiness assessment (FedRAMP) and CAIQ/SIG gap mapping.
- Jul–Sep 2025: remediation sprints and documentation for ISO 27001 controls; internal audit in Aug.
- Q4 2025: third-party ISO certification audit window (target)

FedRAMP notes:
- Readiness assessment will highlight necessary SSP/POA&M items. We do not yet have a sponsor ATO; partner-sponsored path is the realistic option for 2026 ATO timelines.

SOC 2:
- Current Type II period: Sep 2024–Aug 2025. Redacted report can be shared under NDA.

Owners & asks:
- Monica: prepare evidence index (SIG/CAIQ exports), tag items we can share and items that require redaction.
- Neha: coordinate RFP deliverables and send the one-pager.

I've created SEC-428 on Jira to track the AcmeCloud ask and will attach the drive folder.

-Karthik

--

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Thanks — I've uploaded the CAIQ export and a preliminary evidence index to Drive here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cISO_plan (link).

Quick status: 
- CAIQ: ~70% complete; most network and encryption items documented. Remaining work: encryption key lifecycle docs (KMS/HSM) and logging retention specifics for private deployments.
- SOC 2 evidence: common artifacts (change management, incident logs, access reviews) are tagged in the index; redaction required for vendor invoices and a small set of customer-facing extracts.
- ISO gap analysis: attached (ISO-gap-analysis.xlsx) with severity scores and recommended remediation owners.

I've also attached a short FedRAMP-readiness-checklist (stub) summarizing SSP/POA&M expectations. Will refine ahead of the Tue call.

Attachments: FedRAMP-readiness-checklist.docx (stub), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (stub)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Thanks team — the uploads look useful. A few clarifying questions from Acme's security reviewers after an initial scan: 

1) For FedRAMP: are you providing readiness artifacts only or are you targeting an authorization (ATO) in 2026? If ATO, will it be partner-sponsored or self-sponsored?
2) KMS/HSM: can you confirm whether customer-managed keys are supported on private deployments and whether HSM-backed key management is available?
3) Retention policy: what is your default logs/data retention policy for hosted vs. private deployments? We may need a specific statement for the RFP.
4) SOC 2: good to know the Type II period; can you confirm whether the report includes subprocessors and a list of exceptions (if any)?

If you can reply inline to these items that would be perfect. Also please confirm if the next working sync on Tue May 27 at 11:00 AM PT works — we may need an extra 15 minutes.

Best,
Sarah

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@regcompliance.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: ISO/FedRAMP roadmap + evidence for AcmeCloud RFP

Hi Sarah/Carlos — answering inline below and capturing next steps.

1) FedRAMP: current status is readiness assessment (we're not yet ATO). Our tentative plan is to pursue partner-sponsored ATO in 2026; calendar and sponsor discussions ongoing. For the RFP we will provide readiness artifacts and a POA&M summary.

2) KMS/HSM: private deployments support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; HSM-backed key storage is available for Dedicated and Private customers (we rely on cloud HSM or on-prem HSM depending on deployment). Monica will attach an architecture note for key lifecycle.

3) Retention policy: hosted defaults — logs retained 90 days, audit trails 2 years (configurable per customer); private deployments: retention is configurable per contract and we document standard options in the SOC 2 evidence bundle. We will provide a short retention statement for the RFP.

4) SOC 2: the Type II report covers core Redwood subprocessors; we'll provide a redacted version and an exceptions summary under NDA.

Action items and owners:
- Monica: attach key-lifecycle note and updated evidence index (due 05/23).
- Karthik: finalize ISO remediation roadmap (due 06/06).
- Neha: one-page roadmap + RFP statement (due 05/25) and schedule follow-up.

Next sync: Tue, 27 May 2025 at 11:00 AM PT — I've sent a calendar invite for a 45-min working session so we can walk the artifacts with Acme. Please accept when you can.

If Acme needs a redacted SOC 2 now we can send it under the attached mutual NDA link — let me know and I'll queue.

Thanks all — Neha

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments referenced: ISO-gap-analysis.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-index.pdf, FedRAMP-readiness-checklist.docx
